healthy child, and there are four pictures.The first picture shows a girl who goes to bed at 9pm, and gets up at 7am.The second picture shows a girl who is exercising.The third picture shows some fruit and food.The fourth picture shows some sweet food and soft drinks.I think this information sheet will talk about diet, exercise, and life habits.I hope we share the same idea.Pictures usually provide us with a lot of information.They help us to understand the information sheet.Now, let's take a closer look at the four pictures.Picture 1Let's take a closer look at the clock.What time does the girl go to bed?She goes to bed at 9pm.What time does the girl get up?She gets up at 7am.How long does she sleep?Wow, she sleeps for 10 hours.It's a proper amount of sleep for a teenager.I believe she will grow healthy and strong if she keeps this habit.Picture 2What is the girl doing?She is exercising.You can also say she is doing exercise.Let me tell you more about this girl.She exercises every Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday.However, she doesn't exercise on Sundays or Thursdays.She gives herself a rest every Sunday and Thursday.She keeps this habit every week.We can say she exercises regularly.Please read after me.Regularly.Pay attention to the vowels.EREEGEARELEILERegularly.How often does she do it?She does it regularly.Do you exercise regularly?I hope so.Picture 3What kind of food can you see?I can see fruit and vegetables.How is the food?It is fresh and healthy.How many glasses of water can you see?I can see eight glasses of water.Let me tell you more about drinking water.Around 70% of our bodies are made of water.We should drink at least eight glasses of water every day.Picture 4Look at this picture.What can you see on the table?I can see cola, sweets and ice cream.Is the boy thin or fat?He is fat.Why is he fat?Because he eats too much sweet food and drinks too many soft drinks.The boy drinks four cans of cola.He drinks too many soft drinks.He eats three boxes of ice cream.The boy eats too much ice cream.If you want to say something is more than enough,you can say too many or too much.Too many goes with countable nouns,while too much goes with uncountable nouns.Pictures really give us a lot while words offer even more.Now let's read the captions.Boys and girls,please take out your worksheet and do task two.Read the captions quickly and match them with the pictures.羊肉鹽生抽糖生抽油油盐白糖生抽水盐生抽水OK, time is up.Picture 1 goes with caption 4.If you want to stay healthy, you should go to bed early and get up early.If you want to stay healthy, you should exercise regularly.If you want to stay healthy, you should eat a lot of healthy food like fruit and vegetables.And drink at least 8 glasses of water every day.If you want to stay healthy, you should not eat too much sweet food or drink too many soft drinks.Boys and girls, you have read the information sheet and know how to be a healthy child.Now, take out your worksheet and do task 3.Read the information sheet and the table.The table in the worksheet will show you information about Joe, Alice and Joe.Please give the children suggestions on their health based on the information sheet from the camp.
